title: Rectitude Holdings Ltd Ramps up Supply Chain and Fleet Capacity Amid Surging Singapore Construction Demand
summary: Rectitude scales operations and expands its logistics fleet to meet heightened demand for industrial safety commodities and construction products. Driven by a robust pipeline of public infrastructure projects, the Company’s imports of materials and goods soared 32% from January to April 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.
